summary: Add st missions report-to: a person or a run's requester can opt a running run into report-to, change its reporter, or clear it

replay.detail: No history is folded or rebuilt. A run's reporter is read while the run is evaluated: its latest mission-run.report-to claim, else its creation claim, as before.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes or triggers change. The claim vocabulary gains mission-run.report-to (system-only, state-transition, on mission-run) with optional report_to, stalled_after_ms and report_completed fields. The mission-run.created claim is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and their digests are unchanged. The claim registry digest changes with the new kind, as with any vocabulary addition: members on different builds keep replicating claims and skip comparing projection maps until all are upgraded.

compatibility.detail: st missions report-to RUN (--agent AGENT [--stalled-after DURATION] [--report-completed] | --clear) --as ACTOR and POST /v1/mission-runs/{run}/report-to are new. A member on an older build does not know the mission-run.report-to claim kind, so upgrade every member of a fleet before using the command. Runs that never use it are unaffected. Not tested against an older build.

downtime.detail: No restart-specific work. Each evaluated run reads one more claim by an indexed lookup; no timers, scans or replays are added.

manual.detail: Opt-in only. The guide is in docs/st3/mission-graph-runtime.md under Run reports.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary at any time. A run then reports as its creation claim recorded, and a mission-run.report-to claim already written is not read.
